title: Group directory and graphic display
slide_intent: Present the research groups at an arrival point so visitors can identify the people and activities within the lab.
strategic_value: A directory of related glyphs can make research diversity readable as one institutional community.
demonstration: Two adjacent black screens pair a directory of group glyphs and names with an oversized white linear identity graphic.
practical_value: Compare the informative directory with a neighboring graphic display in the same lobby.
